Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer initially identified Gustaf Molander as the director of the film and referenced Wikipedia as a source suggesting his birthplace was Helsinki, Finland. However, this information was not cross-verified with multiple reliable sources as instructed by the Planner. The failure to confirm the birthplace using at least two independent reputable sources led to the propagation of conflicting information (Helsingborg, Sweden vs. Helsinki, Finland) in subsequent steps, creating confusion and preventing resolution of the real-world problem.
